review.assessment:
The change replaces an explicit index-based loop with a concise list comprehension, making the code more Pythonic. It also corrects the filtering logic from truthiness (`if v`) to strict `None` identity checking (`v is not None`). This aligns the implementation with the specification of dropping only `None` entries while preserving all other values, including falsy ones like `0` or `False`.
